notes:
High-level summary:
- Company: NimbleForge Labs — mid-market analytics SaaS building an in-product assistant to help power guided analysis and automated report generation.
- Primary ask: start on Hosted API to validate latency and correctness; if Hosted meets SLOs, evaluate Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable latency and cost.
- Workloads: interactive chat + multi-step agent flows (tool calling to run saved queries, trigger exports), background async agent that composes reports, doc-search for context grounding.
- Latency SLOs: VP Product repeated: "95th percentile (end-to-end agent handoff) must be <300ms; median token latency should be ~<150ms." For streaming UX they'd like token streaming latency to feel <100ms median.
- POC focus: measure token-level latency distribution, tail behavior when KV cache cold, effect of batching on p50/95, impact of function/tool calling on end-to-end latency. Also need to validate streaming + function-calling surface (function schemas, retry behavior).
- Quality gating: want prompt/eval regression gating integrated — create evaluation suites for top 50 prompts, run Redwood Optimize eval harness during POC to set baseline. Acceptance criteria: hallucination rate <2% (domain questions), grounding F1 >0.78, and no regression >5% compared to baseline across canary rollouts. Need automated alerts and rollback on failing canary.
- Ops/Deployment: will likely require VPC/Dedicated for production (data residency + predictability). Interested in KMS integration (AWS KMS) and audit logs long retention.
- Pricing sensitivity: Mid-market — open to 12mo commit if unit costs drop significantly (target ARR $120k-$300k). Main blocker: Dedicated delta vs Hosted cost and legal signoff timeline.
- Quotes / snippets: VP Product: "Latency is non-negotiable — our conversion rate drops if the assistant hesitates." Engineering lead: "We need deterministic rollouts — canary + A/B with automatic prompt-eval gates."
- Artifacts: POC deck (drive link), security questionnaire, Fireflies transcripts (ff_20260302_1031, ff_20260310_1515), Jira tickets opened for infra tuning (INF-3832, INF-3921).
- Next: run extended POC (2 weeks) focusing on steady-state 95th latency; se to deliver Dedicated pricing scenarios and suggested batching/quantization profiles from Redwood Optimize.
